title: Rep. Maria Salazar Disclosed 5 Stock Trades: Procter & Gamble, NVIDIA and Cisco (Oct 2026)
content:
Rep. Maria Elvira Salazar (FL-27) disclosed five stock trades on November 5, 2026, all dated October 23: Procter & Gamble and NVIDIA purchases (two lines each) and a Cisco sale, each in the $1,001–$15,000 band.

Trade data: Bargo, compiled from U.S. House and Senate STOCK Act filings.

Transaction date for all five: Oct 23, 2026. Disclosure date: Nov 5, 2026 (13 days later). Member: Rep. Maria Elvira Salazar, FL-27 (House). Bargo lists two identical lines each for Procter & Gamble and NVIDIA; they are shown as listed and may reflect separate accounts or lots.

What's been disclosed

  • Purchases: Procter & Gamble (PG) and NVIDIA (NVDA), $1,001–$15,000 per line, two lines each, on October 23.
  • One sale: Cisco Systems (CSCO), $1,001–$15,000, on October 23.
  • Price since: Bargo's estimate puts Procter & Gamble about 2.7% higher on November 6 than on October 23, NVIDIA about 11.5% lower and Cisco about 11.9% lower.
  • Timing: the filing came 13 days after the trades, well inside the 45-day window.

Quick FAQ

How long after the trades were they disclosed?
13 days after the trades, which were all dated October 23. The STOCK Act gives members 45 days from the transaction to disclose it.

Why are the amounts ranges?
Filings report value bands such as $15,001–$50,000 instead of exact dollar amounts.

Where does the price comparison come from?
It is Bargo's estimate, comparing the price on the transaction date with the November 6 price. It is not the member's actual execution price.
